characters.name: Zei
characters.voice_notes: Protagonist of the Dzego thread; national Minpentai champion and gifted cryptographer, now supervising drone combat for the Kungaupei and Veridia. Quick, precise, fluent technical explainer; playful with friends; tense, despairing and then elated during the battles (ch26, ch29-30). Occasionally speaks Dzegoban.

characters.name: Fin
characters.age: teen / young adult (Zei's close friend, similar age)
characters.voice_notes: Zei's best friend, active in the Bansunpei (the language-reform body). Quick, upbeat, eager to help; answers an emergency call in the middle of the night.

characters.name: Bansunpei researcher
characters.voice_notes: Unnamed Bansunpei AI researcher on the emergency group chat; brisk, technical, upbeat as results come in. Gender not stated.

characters.name: second Bansunpei researcher
characters.voice_notes: Another unnamed Bansunpei researcher on the group chat; confident, technical, one-ups the first researcher's plan. Gender not stated.

characters.name: Lektor
characters.voice_notes: Respected Veridian general, later head general and overall commander of the Northshore offensive. Forthright, sceptical but open-minded in ch28; loud, firm, commanding when giving orders in ch29-30.

characters.name: Mu
characters.age: older adult (described earlier as an older woman)
characters.voice_notes: Kungaupei member and former Minpentai tournament organiser, a mentor figure to Zei and Bai. Calm, soft-spoken, quietly brilliant improviser who stays cool in a crisis; gentle, with wry humour.

characters.name: Gallowar
characters.voice_notes: Veridian general leading Group North; clipped, businesslike military reports, shouts orders over the command channel.

characters.name: Telpo
characters.voice_notes: Leader of Group Center; short, clipped military reports over the command channel. Gender not stated.

characters.name: Vakaria
characters.voice_notes: Leader of Group Naval (seaborne drones); brisk military reports, a touch of warmth when praising the Northglade locals. Gender not stated.

characters.name: Den
characters.voice_notes: High Council member of the Kungaupei (Dzego's shadow defence organisation), Zei's mentor and mission commander. Composed, authoritative, dry and blunt; leads Group South and is killed in ch29 (his ch30 line is a remembered quote).

notes: L is shared: 30:16 and 30:30 are an unnamed second Bansunpei researcher ('another researcher') in the group chat; 30:51 is General Lektor giving the order (exception). C is an unnamed Bansunpei researcher (tagged at 30:24); I treated all nine C runs as the same person - 30:14, 30:15, 30:18, 30:20 and 30:42 have no speech tag, so that is an assumption (medium confidence; about ten people are in the chat). G (30:47) is Gallowar reporting for Group North, not Gladias; M at 30:49 is Mu reporting for Group South, which she took over after Den's death; V (30:50) is Vakaria; T (30:48) is Telpo. D at 30:58 is a line of Den's that Zei remembers (flashback quote; Den is dead by now). Most speech in this chapter is over the chat/command channel (remote voices). N-coded written text left to the narrator: 30:6, 30:33 and 30:69 are written first-person messages from Deluin on Zei's watch (the first two include long hexadecimal address/key lists; 30:69 ends with a Dzegoban phrase) - you may want Deluin's voice for the prose runs.
